summary.denominator_meaning: Every Lean development on disk, one row per directory.  This is an ENGINEERING denominator -- it says what the repo contains.  It is NOT STATS_RULES.md §1.2's denominator.
summary.not_the_frozen_endpoint: STATS_RULES.md §1.2: the U3 attainment rate's denominator is fixed at 19 sealed games (12 at the clean layer), with no exclusions and no cap.  Nothing on disk today is a sealed game, so the frozen rate is not computable from this census and this census does not claim to compute it.
